title: Oh no! It's Yet Another Pack
description: Oh no! It's yet another kitchen-sink modpack, and yes, it has everything. Tech, magic, dragons, custom spells, and more!
body:
## ⚙️ Tech & Automation
- **Create**: Build elaborate mechanical contraptions and automate using rotating machinery, conveyor belts, and more.
- **Applied Energistics 2**: Manage massive item storage networks and set up powerful auto-crafting systems.
- **Sophisticated Backpacks**: Upgradeable backpacks with filter, refill, and automation upgrade slots.
- **Construction Wand**: Extend and place blocks in bulk with a single click.

## 🔮 Magic
- **Ars Nouveau**: Combine glyphs to craft your own custom spells.
- **Botania**: A nature-themed magic mod centered around generating and spending Mana using flowers and botanical machinery.

## ⚔️ Adventure & Creatures
- **Ice and Fire**: Adds dragons, sea serpents, and other mythological creatures to the world.
- **Tinkers' Construct**: Create and modify tools and weapons from a wide variety of materials with unique traits.

## 🗺️ Exploration & Navigation
- **Waystones**: Place and teleport between waystone markers across the world.
- **Xaero's World Map & Minimap**: Full world map and on-screen minimap with waypoint support.
- **Immersive Portals**: Walk through portals and see the other side rendered in real time.

## 🎨 Visuals & Building
- **Distant Horizons**: Renders far-away terrain as LODs, massively extending your visible view distance.
- **Continuity**: Enables connected textures (e.g. glass panes connecting seamlessly).
- **Not Enough Animations**: Adds more detailed player animations in first and third person.
- **Armourer's Workshop**: Design fully custom cosmetic armor and outfits.
- **Exposure**: A photography mod; craft cameras and develop film to create in-game photos.
